hook: Jio hits *542.4 million* users as ARPU climbs to *Rs 218.8*
hook_b: Jio ARPU is up. Is your network worth it?
tldr: Jio Platforms' ARPU rose to Rs 218.8 and subscribers reached 542.4 million in Reliance's Q2 results.

beats.what: NDTV Profit's takeaways: Jio ARPU rose to Rs 218.8, subscriber base 542.4 million, while Reliance Retail profit fell 6.67% sequentially.
beats.why: ARPU is the average revenue each user pays per month, so a rising ARPU points to higher bills or more spend per user.
beats.care: Higher ARPU can show up as costlier plans over time. Rate your own network below.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV Profit reports Jio ARPU Rs 218.8 and 542.4 million subscribers; Reliance Retail profit down 6.67% sequentially. Other segment figures were not in the summary.
